name: Dranik Heartlands: Plains
summary: The open plains of Dranik, scarred by war and corrupted by Discord energy.
description: The Plains form the outermost and most exposed area of the Dranik Heartlands. Once fertile Dragorn farmland, the region is now a war‑torn expanse of scorched earth, corrupted wildlife, and Muramite patrol routes. Discord energy bleeds into the land from nearby ruptures, warping vegetation and destabilizing the terrain. Dragorn resistance fighters use hidden shelters and natural cover to strike at Muramite forces. The Plains serve as the entry point into the deeper Heartlands.
